title: Kujieleza kwa Ufasaha (Theme 11: Ushuru)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child listens for what the narration teaches, then tells his own in order with gestures that fit.

floor.prerequisite: Answers who and what after hearing a short story.
floor.question: Hadithi ilimhusu nani?

representations: a mirror or a partner for gestures
steps: Say the message in one sentence.
Plan your story in three parts.
contexts: telling a story at the evening fire

board.do: wanakijiji waliojenga barabara kwa pesa za ushuru
Point at the three picture cards.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child orders the cards and retells the story with one gesture for each part.

misconceptions.repair: Ujumbe ni funzo la masimulizi yote; jambo moja ni maelezo tu.
Simulia kwa mpangilio: mwanzo, kati, mwisho.

misconceptions.ask: Uso wako unaonyesha hisia gani hapa?
misconceptions.repair: Ishara na sura yako ziendane na unachosema.

listen_for: Then tukaenda home, ilikuwa poa sana.
misconceptions.ask: Ni neno lipi si la Kiswahili?
misconceptions.repair: Simulia kwa Kiswahili sanifu: kisha, nyumbani, nzuri.

checks.question: Ujumbe wa masimulizi kuhusu wanakijiji waliojenga barabara kwa pesa za ushuru ni upi?
checks.answer: Tukilipa ushuru, serikali hutujengea huduma kama barabara na shule.
